office_change.note: Paired lines naming this office on one side and a different office group (or no district office) on the other. They are held out of the office's district-card figures and counted in the FY2027 House bill residual (office_change_php); those printed under this office are still among this list's rows and sums.

officeLens.tier_meaning: Tier A: the office serves one district, so its figure can be read as that district’s. Tier B: the office serves several districts, so the figure is shared and is not split between them.
officeLens.note: These are the rows the documents print under this office. The office is associated with the districts listed; no row is assigned to any one of them, and a Tier B office's sums are never split between its districts. Lines in office_change (their NEP and House bill sides name different offices) and in no_office are held out of the office's district-card figures. Money on no district card is the residual in the districts list.

disclaimers.title: No allegations.
disclaimers.body: An insertion, deletion, or amount-change candidate describes a provisional comparison between identified sources. That classification alone does not establish irregularity or wrongdoing by any office or official and should not be represented as such. Absence from an API snapshot likewise does not establish absence from the published NEP or concealment.

disclaimers.title: Office and legislative-district associations.
disclaimers.body: The DEO mapping associates offices with legislative districts; it does not establish that a representative requested, sponsored, or controlled a project, or that each project lies in every district associated with its office. Shared-office totals remain undivided and must not be split among the districts served. Office-based views must retain attribution tiers, co-served districts, unattributable residuals, and upstream uncertainty annotations. Historical or undated amounts retained as mapping evidence are separate from the FY2027 project ledger and must not be quoted as FY2027 allocations. See the DEO mapping restrictions.

meta.notice: Independent and unofficial. This comparison is our own reading of the published documents, not an official record of the budget department, the agencies or the House. Figures are the amounts published in the documents, not spending. No allegations. An insertion, deletion, or amount-change candidate describes a provisional comparison between identified sources. That classification alone does not establish irregularity or wrongdoing by any office or official and should not be represented as such. Absence from an API snapshot likewise does not establish absence from the published NEP or concealment. Read the full notice: https://budget.bettergov.ph/hgab/2027/methodology#disclaimer.
meta.note: One row per comparison record. status_label is the plain status; trace is the raw code. Pairings are candidates, not confirmed changes; held = true marks an unconfirmed match. sums are per version over every matched row (not just this page). The NEP and the House bill are two versions of one budget: compare them, never add them.
